run.name: 02-kinetic-quote
run.finalText:
The quote is built as four phrases on the 8s "Main" composition, each handing off to the next. I checked it on a contact sheet and two stills. The last two stills, taken after I shrank the emphasis line, look right.

| Time | Phrase | Animation |
|---|---|---|
| 0.2s | "Design is not" | Words pop up one by one, then it lifts and fades out around 2s. |
| 2.0s | "just what it looks like." | Letters rise in one at a time as the first phrase leaves, then it drifts up and fades around 3.5s. |
| 3.8s | "Design is" | Words drop in from above. It stays on screen, shifts up and dims to a grey header. |
| 4.7s | "how it works." | Pink, heavy, 135px, so it's the biggest and boldest line. Letters spring in with a slight rotation, then it slowly scales up. |
| 6.4s | "— Steve Jobs" | Small grey line that fades in last. |

The first frame of the contact sheet showed "how it works." wrapping onto two lines at 170px, so I dropped it to 135px to keep it on one line.

I can make the emphasis line even bigger by stacking "how it" over "works.", or add a background colour shift when it lands.

items.text: emphasis: one phrase larger or bolder than the rest
